name: gizza-ai/csv-sort
summary: Sort CSV rows by one or more columns

tool.description: Sort the rows of a CSV/TSV by one or more columns. `columns` is a comma-separated priority list of column names (when header=true) or 1-based indices; each may carry a ':asc'/':desc' suffix for its own direction, else `order` (asc/desc) applies. `numeric` is auto (numeric when a column is all numbers, so 2<10, else lexical), number, or text. case_sensitive controls text ordering; the header row stays on top. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Runs locally.

case_sensitive.description: For text ordering, make A–Z case-sensitive (uppercase sorts before lowercase). Default false.

columns.description: Sort column(s), comma-separated in priority order: column names (when header=true) or 1-based indices. Each may carry a ':asc'/':desc' suffix to set its own direction (else the global order applies). e.g. 'age' or 'dept:asc,salary:desc'.

data.description: The CSV text (with a header row unless header=false).

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (kept on top; columns can be named). With false, sort every row and address columns by 1-based index. Default true.

numeric.description: Ordering: 'auto' sorts a column numerically when every value is a number (so 2 < 10), else lexically; 'number' forces numeric; 'text' forces lexical. Default 'auto'.

order.description: Default sort direction for columns without their own ':asc'/':desc' suffix. Default 'asc'.
